tools.name: trading_day
tools.description: Exchange-local trading date and civil/incoming night attribution. Mainland China and the 24 MO scopes; SGX is equity/FX/rates, HKEX is cash equities. Outside published coverage is unknown. Official exchange notices take precedence.

tools.name: next_closure
tools.description: Next published exchange holiday or half-day from the fixed MO static calendar list; weekends alone are not holiday events. No extrapolation beyond coverage. Official exchange notices take precedence.

tools.name: trading_hours
tools.description: FC product session templates, explicit day-offset units and special hours under data contract v0.1. Date selects the exchange-local schedule; no real-time market status or prices. Missing prerequisites are unknown. Official exchange notices take precedence.

tools.name: contract_expiry
tools.description: Published FC last-trading/first-notice dates for a product and optional YYYYMM delivery month (default next published month). Never runs an expiry engine; unpublished months are unknown with a product-page link. Official exchange notices take precedence.

tools.name: recent_rule_changes
tools.description: CEC published rule changes: margin, price limits, position/opening limits, fees, delivery and listing. Requested window at most 90 days; reports actual available window, never current parameter history. Official Chinese exchange notices take precedence.

tools.name: recent_notices
tools.description: CEC published notice records in Chinese or available English summaries; at most 30 days. Falls back to Chinese when English is unavailable, without translation. Published records are not verified current rules. Official Chinese exchange notices take precedence.
